setup.upstream_receipts: Deterministic synthetic harness receipts prepared already-completed research/script tasks. Their pass statuses are fixture setup, not measured research quality.

limitations: These are documentation/skill probes on one archived long episode, not a broad reliability or performance benchmark.
No AI image generation, draft/final visual inspection, MP4 viewing, publication or live A/B was performed.
The research/script stage was seeded, not newly executed or fact-checked.
The observation probe uses synthetic data and is not evidence of CTR growth or actual channel audience changes.
